answer: Because the juniper release is recorded with every signature, the mesa audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the prism graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 34 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
